About Karnet Solutions

A local ISP built on straight answers and stable connections.

Karnet Solutions started as a small Church Circle set-up box and grew into one of Tumkur's most trusted internet providers. We lay our own fibre, employ our own technicians, and answer our own support calls — no outsourced call centres, no vague timelines. Just a local team that treats every household and business connection like it matters.

Our Mission

Deliver dependable, affordable fibre internet to every home and business in Tumkur, backed by real local support.

Our Vision

To be the internet provider Tumkur recommends by word of mouth, one reliable connection at a time.

  • Own fibre infrastructure across Tumkur — no third-party bandwidth resellers.
  • In-house technicians who pick up the phone, not a ticketing queue.
  • Plans priced clearly, with no silent add-ons at billing time.

Common Questions

Frequently asked questions.

Still unsure about something? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll answer directly.

Most new home connections are installed within 24-48 hours of a confirmed site visit, provided fibre already runs through your layout. Areas needing a new trunk line may take a few days longer — we'll confirm this during the free survey.
We currently serve 30+ localities including Church Circle, B.H. Road, Vasavi Nagar, Gokul Layout, Ashoknagar and Shettihalli. Share your pin code on WhatsApp and we'll confirm coverage right away.
All our home and business plans are unlimited data at the plan's listed speed. There's no fair-usage cap or speed throttling after a certain volume.
Yes. Static IP is available with our business internet and leased line plans, useful for hosting, remote access, billing software and CCTV viewing.
We handle shifting within Tumkur for a nominal re-installation charge, subject to fibre availability at the new address. Give us at least 3 working days' notice where possible.
We accept UPI, bank transfer and cash to our field collection team. A payment reminder and link is sent by WhatsApp a few days before your due date.
